Hi Billy,

I just installed "rmarkdown" on a couple of CentOS servers with different versions of R, and also on Ubuntu. It was successful in all cases. Can you try installing this again? May be for some reason the downloaded file got corrupted? 
This is unlikely, but possible that there could be an issue with file/directory permissions. Can you check the contents and permissions of "/tmp/Rtmp5i4HDt" (or whatever temp directory your install points to).

messages.subject: Re: Rmarkdown Installation error on Shiny server , CentOS 6.4 x64
parts:
Ok .... for some strange reason , devtools wasn't downloading the master.zip to the tempdir() ...

Here is what I did ..

1) download the file using wget , wget https://github.com/rstudio/rmarkdown/archive/master.zip
2) copy it to the directory listed when I run tempdir()
3) run the devtools::install_github("rstudio/rmarkdown")
4) Profit!

And it works ... Perhaps because I have both shiny-server and rstudio-server both on the same server? No idea. But hope it gives another way of solving the issue to some other people who are also facing the same issue.

Thanks Fereshteh and Everyone!
